note: Shawnee National Forest campground on the site of a Civilian Conservation Corps work camp, west of Route 1 south of Harrisburg. Level primitive sites with a fire ring and table; water spigot and vault toilets central. Shared with equestrian campers: the campground is designated for horses and their stock, beside the River to River and Beaver trailhead. Fees are cash or check. --Claude
